sec: CKDu theories flowchart, epidemiology & clinical features · p795

items.q: Match each proposed CKDu factor with its place in the flowchart — 1) Heat stress  2) Agrochemicals  3) Fluoride in ground water … A) All arrow into CKDu interstitial fibrosis  B) None relates to CKDu
opts: All three are proposed contributors to CKDu
Only heat stress contributes, the others being unrelated
Only agrochemicals contribute to the fibrosis and tubular atrophy
None of these three factors appears in the CKDu flowchart
items.exp: Proposed theories for CKDu (→ interstitial fibrosis & tubular atrophy): heat stress, agrochemicals and fluoride in ground water, with heavy metals (cadmium) and communicable disease from the right. (Book p795)

items.q: Match the right-sided contributors to CKDu — 1) Heavy metals  2) Communicable disease … A) Example given is cadmium  B) Also listed as a proposed factor
items.exp: CKDu flowchart right side: heavy metals — e.g. cadmium — and communicable disease. (Book p795)

items.q: A middle-aged man from the eastern coast of India, working as a farmer in the heat, presents with renal failure without diabetes or hypertension. Which entity fits?
opts: CKDu — CKD of unknown etiology, reported on the eastern coast of India in middle-aged men
Diabetic kidney disease, presenting with heavy proteinuria and diabetic retinopathy
Autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease with bilateral enlarged cystic kidneys
Medullary sponge kidney presenting with recurrent stones and nephrocalcinosis
items.exp: CKDu epidemiology: eastern coast of India, middle-aged men, with no precipitating disease. (Book p795)

items.q: Fill up: CKDu is reported on the ______ coast of India and in middle-aged men.
items.exp: Epidemiology of CKDu: eastern coast of India, middle-aged men. (Book p795)

items.q: CKDu is described as asymptomatic until:
opts: The serum creatinine value has doubled
items.exp: CKDu box: asymptomatic until ESRF — edema and hypertension are late features, proteinuria is absent or mild. (Book p795)

items.q: In CKDu, oedema and hypertension are late features rather than early ones.
opts: False — oedema and hypertension are the earliest features
False — oedema never occurs in CKDu
items.exp: CKDu box: asymptomatic until ESRF, with oedema and hypertension as late features. (Book p795)

items.q: Match each CKDu box finding — 1) Proteinuria  2) Tubular biomarkers  3) Outcome … A) Elevated  B) Absent/mild  C) ESRF
items.exp: CKDu box: absent/mild proteinuria, elevated tubular biomarkers, and progression to ESRF. (Book p795)

items.q: A patient from an endemic CKDu area has a normal urine dipstick for protein but a raised tubular biomarker. Which statement from the flowchart explains this?
opts: CKDu causes absent/mild proteinuria with elevated tubular biomarkers
CKDu always causes nephrotic-range proteinuria with generalised oedema
Tubular biomarkers fall early while proteinuria appears later in CKDu
Proteinuria is the first manifestation, appearing long before renal failure
items.exp: CKDu box: absent/mild proteinuria, elevated tubular biomarkers, and progression to ESRF. (Book p795)

items.q: All but one of the following are proposed in the CKDu theories flowchart. Which is the odd one out?
items.exp: CKDu theories: heat stress, agrochemicals, fluoride in ground water, heavy metals (cadmium) and communicable disease; NSAIDs are not in this flowchart. (Book p795)

items.q: The clinical features of CKDu given in the box are:
items.exp: Clinical features of CKDu: anemia + proteinuria. (Book p795)

items.q: Fill up: The clinical features of CKDu listed are anemia and ______.
items.exp: CKDu clinical features: anemia + proteinuria, illustrating that tubular-interstitial damage produces anaemia early. (Book p795)

items.q: A 45-year-old farmer from the eastern coast of India is found to have ESRF with only mild proteinuria and no diabetes or hypertension. Which statement is most consistent with CKDu?
opts: The disease is asymptomatic until ESRF, with oedema and hypertension as late features
The disease presents early with nephrotic-range proteinuria and generalised oedema
The disease is a hereditary ciliopathy with multiple bilateral renal cysts
The disease always begins in childhood with rickets and growth failure
items.exp: CKDu: no precipitating disease, asymptomatic until ESRF, with oedema/hypertension as late features and absent or mild proteinuria. (Book p795)
